spans.s: ष्णु r. 2nd cl. (-स्नौति) To distil, to drop, to ooze or leak.
ष्णुच् r. 1st cl. (स्नोचते) To be clear or pellucid.

ष्णुस्(उ)ष्णुसु r. 4th cl. (स्नुस्यति)
 1. To eat.
 2. To take.
 3. To disappear.
4. To eject from the mouth.
ष्णुह् (ऌ ऊ) r. 4th cl. (स्नुह्यति) To be sick, to retch, to throw up, to vomit.
